parameters.name: AllocationType
parameters.description:
The allocation type. Valid values:

*   Normal: queries SCUs that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account.
*   Shared: queries SCUs shared between the Alibaba Cloud account and RAM users.

Default value: Normal.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.description: The capacity of the SCU. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20, 40, 100, 200, 500, 1024, 2048, 5120, 10240, 20480, and 51200.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the SCU. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the SCU. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The states of SCUs. The array is 1 to 4 in length.

parameters.name: StorageCapacityUnitId
parameters.description: The IDs of the SCUs. You can specify 1 to 100 SCU IDs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the SCU. You can add up to 20 tags.
